items.title: 68088_Wilbur B. Ware, Sr oral history interview
items.q: Same group -- Pat Patrick, Beaver Harris, myself. We get to Boston... That gig... I got Pat Patrick.

ctx.x: When you were coming up, it seems that people did it for the love of playing.

Well, that was the whole thing. That's another thing I admire about Thelonius. He was saying something -- Patrick asked him, say, "Man, what do you think about the music? Monk said, 'It's so fast, it took the beauty out of music?' Actually, he doesn't want to play anymore.
